# GoCart Global

> Hand-picked ultra-luxury hotels, resorts and private pool villas around the world — for honeymoons, anniversaries, golf and wellness escapes. Data-backed picks, bookable on Agoda.

GoCart Global publishes data-backed guides to five-star hotels, resorts and private villas worldwide. Every hotel list comes from live Agoda search data (five-star only, confirmed nightly price incl. taxes, 30+ reviews) and is refreshed regularly; prices are indicative at the time of the last check.

Right now we track live nightly rates at 274 five-star hotels across 30 destinations — 289 rates checked, most recently on October 10, 2026.

## Destination guides
- [Where to Stay in Bali for Luxury: Uluwatu, Ubud, Nusa Dua and More](https://gocartglobal.com/articles/bali-where-to-stay-luxury): Where to stay in Bali for a luxury trip: Uluwatu cliffs, Ubud jungle, Nusa Dua beaches, Seminyak and Jimbaran compared, plus how to split a stay and when to go.
- [Dubai vs Abu Dhabi: Where to Stay for an Ultra-Luxury Beach or City Trip](https://gocartglobal.com/articles/dubai-vs-abu-dhabi-ultra-luxury): Dubai or Abu Dhabi for an ultra-luxury stay? Palm Jumeirah, Downtown and Saadiyat compared, plus culture, desert trips, dress etiquette and best months.
- [Maldives vs Mauritius vs Seychelles: Choosing Your Honeymoon Island](https://gocartglobal.com/articles/indian-ocean-honeymoon-maldives-mauritius-seychelles): Maldives, Mauritius or Seychelles for a honeymoon? Compare island character, daily life, flights, combining islands and the best season for each.
- [Ryokan vs Luxury Hotel in Kyoto and Hakone: How to Choose and Combine](https://gocartglobal.com/articles/kyoto-hakone-ryokan-vs-luxury-hotel): Ryokan or five-star hotel in Kyoto and Hakone? What a ryokan stay includes, onsen etiquette, kaiseki, a Tokyo–Hakone–Kyoto route and the best seasons.
- [Maldives Overwater Villas: How to Choose the Right Luxury Resort](https://gocartglobal.com/articles/maldives-overwater-villas-how-to-choose): How to choose a Maldives overwater villa resort: which atoll, seaplane vs speedboat, house reefs, beach vs water villas, meal plans and the best months.
- [Phuket vs Koh Samui: Which Thai Island Is Best for a Luxury Trip?](https://gocartglobal.com/articles/phuket-vs-koh-samui-luxury): Phuket or Koh Samui for a luxury Thai island trip? Compare access, beaches, villas and monsoon timing on the Andaman and Gulf coasts, plus how to combine both.
